name: RulesList
title: Templates/Platform/View/RulesList
summary: An ordered list of rules grouped by phase, the Rules tab of an application or a firewall. A `PageHeader` with Documentation and Add Rule sits over a search `Input` and a flush `Card` holding an `Accordion` with one item per phase (Request, Response), each trigger reading the phase and its rule count and each panel a data-driven `TableRoot` (scrolling sideways when narrow) with the grip, Move, Name, Description, Status and Last modified. The table is `reorderable`: its grip drags the row or moves it with the arrow keys, Home and End, and `row-reorderable` pins the locked rule; a Move cell adds Move up and Move down `IconButton`s; every move is announced in a polite status region and focus follows the moved rule. A leading locked rule (the default rule) keeps first place and cannot be turned off; a search turns reordering off and says so in an info `Alert`. The Status cell is a `Switch` that turns a rule on or off without losing its place. Any change raises a `SaveBar` with Discard and Review changes; Review changes opens a `Dialog` listing, per phase, every rule that moves (from and to) and every rule turned on or off, with Cancel and Save, and a danger `Alert` in the dialog when the save fails. A success toast confirms the saved order. Built from `PageHeader`, `Button`, `Input`, `Alert`, `Card`, `Accordion`, `TableRoot`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `Tag`, `Switch`, `EmptyState`, `SaveBar`, `Dialog` and its parts, `PanelHeader`, `PanelContent`, `PanelFooter`; its toasts go through `toast` into the app's one toast region (ToastPlugin, or one Toaster at the app root), never a Toaster in the page body. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.

variants.name: Firewall
variants.summary: A firewall's rules: one Request phase, five rules and no locked rule, so every rule moves; the page says rules run until one refuses the request.

variants.name: ReviewChanges
variants.summary: After two moves and one rule turned on: the SaveBar counts the changes and the Review changes dialog is open, listing Docs rewrite moving from 5 to 3 (and the rules it pushed down), Maintenance page turned on, and Security headers moving to the top of the Response phase.

variants.name: SaveFailed
variants.summary: The same changes after a failed save: the dialog stays open with a danger Alert saying the rules still run in the saved order, and Save reads Save again; the next attempt saves and closes the dialog with the success toast.

variants.name: Searching
variants.summary: A search for cache narrows both phases to their matches, the counts read n of total, an info Alert says reordering is off while searching, and every Order control is disabled with the reason in its name and tooltip.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: A firewall with no rules: the Request phase panel shows a small EmptyState with Add Rule instead of the table.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the rules load: both phases read Loading, the search is disabled, and each table shows three skeleton rows shaped like the columns.

variants.name: EditRule
variants.summary: The list composed with `platform/edit/rule-builder`: a rule's name opens the large rule-builder `Drawer` as Edit Rule, seeded with that rule's criteria and behaviors and its phase locked; Add Rule in the header (or in an empty phase) opens it as Add Rule in that phase. Saving an edit updates the row in place and confirms it in a toast; a new rule lands last in its phase, the phase opens, and the toast offers Edit. Neither changes the run order, so the SaveBar only counts moves and status switches.
